findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 128px from the left edge but only to 50px from the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "ALPUKAT" (screen 5, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 5 screens in a row: "JUS ALPUKAT"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 5 of 12 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 1, 2, 3, 4, 10.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 16px on the left, 2px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
